body.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: original Battle of Gods full-body pixel animation source sheet, transparent alpha, no background.
Reference 1 is the previous FOUR-ROW King motion sheet: preserve this exact character, short proportions, navy jacket, white cuffs/hem, black trousers, brown gloves/boots, red scarf, black hair and dark pixel outlines. Reference 2 is the accepted native King identity. CHANGE THE ARMS AND POSTURES TO WIELD A HEAVY GREATSWORD WITH TWO HANDS, both closed brown palms side-by-side along the same short imaginary hilt, each attached through a visible sleeve to his shoulders. No separated floating hand. One arm crosses toward the other hand; elbows bend, hips and shoulders transmit weight. DO NOT DRAW ANY BLADE, HANDLE, WEAPON OR EFFECT: bodies/gloves only, we attach the existing rigid sword afterward.
Output exactly FOUR ROWS of TWELVE complete well-separated chronological full-body cels, preferably 2048x1536. No labels, grid, shadows or particles. Uniform head/body size and one pixel density across ALL 48 cels; no enlarging the spinning/airborne King. Complete boots, connected heads/necks/scarf and crisp outlines. Mostly right-facing; spin row explicitly turns.
Each row columns1-4 are preparation, columns5-10 are six strike keys, columns11-12 are follow-through. Both palms stay CLOSE TOGETHER as two hands on one hilt, not two fists far apart. Imaginary blade points opposite the direction from the forward/high hand to the rear/lower hand. Make the glove pair axis visibly rotate with the cut; do not change only the body or put an arm behind his back.
Row1 FRONT SLASH: 1 right-facing two-hand ready near waist;2 coil knees/hips blade imagined rear-up;3 two-handed raised load;4 ready blade upper-right;5 upper-right blade angle -60degrees;6 -36deg;7 -12deg;8 +12deg;9 +36deg;10 +60deg;11 heavy low-front followthrough;12 low-front load for return. Gaze right, torso rotates/lunges a little, feet plant, enormous weight despite quick cut.
Row2 RETURN:1 exact low-front preparation after Row1;2 weight loads rear foot;3 palms lower-front;4 return begins low;5 +60deg;6 +36deg;7 +12deg;8 -12deg;9 -36deg;10 -60deg;11 raised front finish;12 waist-height preparation for spin. Both hands together; same enemies ahead, King doesn't turn backwards.
Row3 SPIN:1 right-facing knees coil hands close at waist;2 torso winds;3 right-facing pivot starts;4 sweep ready;5 RIGHT with blade +30deg;6 DOWN/front with blade +102deg;7 LEFT/front three-quarter with blade +174deg;8 UP/back-left with blade +246deg;9 UP/back-right with blade +318deg;10 RIGHT with blade +390deg, completing ONE full turn;11 right-facing finish;12 knees bend ready for jump. BOTH ARMS AND PALMS wield one hilt throughout. Back-facing hair-only head, scarf nape. No sword, no glow.
Row4 JUMP STRIKE:1 right-facing crouch both hands above shoulder;2 deeper loading;3 small airborne tucked knees, two hands overhead;4 airborne overhead ready;5 blade imaginary -85deg two palms overhead;6 -50deg;7 -10deg;8 +30deg;9 +60deg;10 +70deg heavy landing crouch, two hands front-low;11 recoil through bent knees;12 ordinary right-facing two-hand ready. Only brief jump; no giant silhouette.
Transparent gaps between ALL bodies. Do not copy another game's art. No one-handed strike in this sheet. Preserve King's small native proportions, intact torso and readable arms.

contacts.prompt:
Create an original TRANSPARENT pixel sprite animation source for Battle of Gods. Reference: exact King character identity, palette and short proportions, black spiky hair, crimson scarf, navy coat, white cuffs/hem, brown gloves/boots. No new armor. EXACTLY THREE ROWS OF SIX complete isolated sprites, wide transparent padding, crisp charcoal edges. Each King has TWO visible connected bent arms, and TWO DISTINCT brown gloved palms stacked on ONE small vivid MAGENTA training handle. The handle is short, a narrow bright pink rod with no guard and NO blade, reaching through both gloves; it lets us locate/replace the hilt offline. The front hand and rear hand visibly grip the same handle 1 glove-width apart; neither arm is behind the back. IMPORTANT TWO HANDS, not a single glove containing both anchors. Show the crossing forearm and the supporting bent elbow. Same body/head size for all18 cels, connected neck/scarf, complete boots. Transparent background, no labels/shadows/particles. This is a two-hand greatsword grip, not boxing and not two weapons. Slight knees/hip bracing communicates weight.
Directions describe the invisible blade, which points from the rear palm toward the front palm.
Row1 SIX consecutive RIGHT-facing front slash contact cels: the blade points upper-right at -60degrees, -36degrees, -12degrees, +12degrees, +36degrees, lower-right +60degrees. Palms stay on the same magenta handle throughout; elbow/body lean goes from braced high load through extended front stroke to low knees. King always gazes right.
Row2 SIX RIGHT-facing returning stroke contact cels: blade lower-right +60degrees, +36degrees, +12degrees, -12degrees, -36degrees, upper-right -60degrees. Same two-hand grip, hips and torso return against weight, gaze right. NOT a backwards turn.
Row3 SIX RIGHT-facing short jump slam contact cels: blade near vertical up -85degrees (both hands above head); then -50degrees, -10degrees, +30degrees, +60degrees and +70degrees. First cel knees tucked in air, then lowering into deep planted crouch. Both palms grip the rod at ALL angles with intact shoulders, wrists/sleeves. Keep body density unchanged; airborne body isn't larger.
No sword blade or slashes, just the short vivid pink grip scaffold through the two brown gloves. No white objects except King's cuffs/hem. Exact3x6 layout, every cel readable and separated. Original art, preserve the reference King's body and head shape.
